function scanWallpapers(path) {
    if (!path) return
    console.log("[theme_panel] escaneando fondos en:", path)
    let rev = ++scanRevision   // nueva revisión
    wallScanner.running = false
    wallScanner.command = [
        "find", path,
        "-maxdepth", "1",
        "-type", "f",
        "(",
        "-iname", "*.jpg", "-o",
        "-iname", "*.jpeg", "-o",
        "-iname", "*.png", "-o",
        "-iname", "*.webp", "-o",
        "-iname", "*.bmp",
        ")"
    ]
    // Pasar la revisión como propiedad dinámica (no hay otra forma directa en QML)
    wallScanner.revision = rev
    wallScanner.targetPath = path
    wallScanner.running = true
}
